newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Jelmoli in 1996 profit, sees 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Jelmoli in 1996 profit, sees 1997 profit.

text.p: Swiss retail group Jelmoli Holding AG said 1996 group net profit would probably be around 45 million Swiss francs and it was planning to pay a dividend of possibly 28 francs per share.
This year's profits were expected to be around 50 million francs.
Jelmoli, which has been through a major restructuring process, also said group sales were 1.888 billion francs last year, but this was hardly comparable to 1995's 2.001 billion.
On a comparable basis, 1996 sales fell 1.4 percent.
In 1995 Jelmoli reported a loss of 13.4 million francs.
"The group net profit (after deduction of minorities) will already reach around 45 million in 1996," Jelmoli said.
Based on expected future profits of around 50 million francs, the board has decided to ask shareholders to approve a dividend for the 1996 transition year, Jelmoli said.
The final size of the dividend will be announced on April 15, but it will probably be 28 francs per bearer share, it added.
The excellent prospects for 1997 are based on two pillars -- Properties (a vacancy rate of two percent) and Fust AG, profitable for 30 years.
